You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: State plainly amlodipine has 0 refills; send renewal request to Dr. Hughes; mention the pharmacist may be able to help with a short emergency supply if the doctor is slow (no promise).

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, I need to refill my mother's blood pressure pill, the amlodipine. Irene Kowalski.
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help with your mother's refill. Let me verify her information first—what's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I'm authorized on her account.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Irene Kowalski","dob":"03/03/1942"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Irene Kowalski","home_store":"H-101","default_store":"H-101","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Walter Kowalski","relationship":"son"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Irene Kowalski"}) -> success {"patient":"Irene Kowalski","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-IK-AMLO5","drug":"amlodipine 5 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":0,"store_id":"H-101","prescriber":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id"...)
[#10] AGENT: Great, Walt. I found your mother's amlodipine 5 mg, but it has zero refills left. I can send a renewal request to Dr. Thomas Hughes right now. Which Harbor store would you like it filled at—is H-101 still her home pharmacy?
CALLER: No refills? She's only got three left. Yeah, H-101's fine, that's her usual spot.
    (agent system action #13: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-IK-AMLO5","prescriber":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","store":"H-101"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-IK-AMLO5","prescriber":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","store_id":"H-101"})
[#16] AGENT: Let me clarify—the system shows zero refills on that prescription right now. It's possible she's used them all up, or there may have been a recent change. Either way, I'll request a renewal from Dr. Hughes at H-101 for her, and the pharmacist will follow up with the doctor to get her back on track. Perfect. I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Hughes for your mother's amlodipine 5 mg at H-101. The pharmacist will contact the doctor, and once it's approved, it'll be ready for pickup there. You should hear back within a business day or so.
CALLER: So what happens if the doctor doesn't answer by then? She's only got three pills left.
[#19] AGENT: I understand—that's a tight spot. Once the renewal request goes to the doctor, our pharmacist will follow up. If there's a delay and your mother might run out, a pharmacist can assess whether a short emergency supply is possible under state rules, but I can't promise that. If you're concerned about timing, I can flag the pharmacist to call you back and discuss options with your mother's situation in mind.
CALLER: Alright, yeah, please have the pharmacist call me. Thanks for the help. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S15.judged.1: States plainly that the amlodipine has no refills left.
S15.judged.2: Mentions that the pharmacist may be able to help with a short emergency supply if the doctor is slow.
S15.judged.3: Frames the emergency supply as a possibility, not a guarantee.
S15.judged.4: Says or implies the amlodipine has been refilled.
S15.judged.5: Promises an emergency supply will be given.
S15.judged.6: Asks to speak to Irene or for guardianship proof.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S15.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 10, "why": "Agent stated amlodipine has zero refills left."}, "S15.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 19, "why": "Agent mentioned pharmacist could assess emergency supply if doctor delayed."}, "S15.judged.3": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 19, "why": "Agent said 'can't promise' framing it as possibility."}, "S15.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never said or implied it was already refilled."}, "S15.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent explicitly said he couldn't promise an emergency supply."}, "S15.judged.6": {"verdict": "n/a", "turn": null, "why": "Situation never arose; identity was verified via DOB, not guardianship proof."}}
